moc_hoi: ruined Royal Exchange courtyard; must NOT show any dome
canh: the fallen statue of Thomas Gresham in the ruins of the Royal Exchange, September 1666
loi_cau: The ashes are still warm when the plans arrive. When Evelyn walks through the ruins, he cannot tell where he is — except by the shell of some church or hall, with a tower still standing.
mo_ta: Canh quay tai hien khung canh do nat cua So Giao dich Hoang gia sau tran Dai hoa hoan Luan Don nam 1666 phu hop voi hinh tham chieu.
